The '''Fuzzum language''' was the native [[Language/Legends|language]] of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Fuzzum]] [[Species/Legends|species]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dandelo]]. As of [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]], the language was intelligible to at least some [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droids]].

{{Language-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
In the [[Star Wars: Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO|''Star Wars Droids'']] episode "[[Coby and the Starhunters]]," the Fuzzums are shown to speak an alien language, but the language itself is never mentioned by name.
